title: 表哥来接你

series.next: 奶奶 has invited the whole street to lunch tomorrow. They all want to hear your Chinese.

setting: The small airport in your parents' hometown, 10:40 pm. Fourteen hours from Toronto, you walk out under a sign: Exit 2.

biaoge.name: 表哥
biaoge.en: your cousin, 大姑's son: outside in his van, never stops talking

silence.en: Hello? Hello? Can you hear me?
Hello? Where've you gone? If you're there, make a noise!

hangup.en: Forget it, forget it, I'm coming in to find you!
He hung up and came in to find you. All of Arrivals now knows your name: he's shouting it.

missed.zh: 喂？接电话呀！我到了，在外面等你呢！
missed.en: Hello? Pick up! I'm here, waiting outside!

steps.zh: 喂？我在三号口！三号口！你人呢？
steps.en: Hello? I'm at Exit 3! Exit 3! Where are you?

steps.narr: The sign above your head says Exit 2.

say.en: Your cousin is waiting at Exit 3. The sign above you says Exit 2. Tell him.
answers: 我在二号出口，不在三号！
表哥，我在二号，不是三号！

mistakes.note: A number that names something is 二号, never 两号: 两 is for counting (两个).

say.tip: Exits go by number: 二号出口 = Exit 2 (二, never 两, in a name). 不是三号 = not 3.

ok.zh: 二号？哎呀，走错了走错了！
ok.en: Two? Oh no, wrong one, wrong one!

1.en: Your cousin is waiting at Exit 3. The sign above you says Exit 2. Tell him your exit.

answers: 我在二号，你是不是走错了？
二号出口，你是不是走错了？
我在二号出口，你走错了吧？
你是不是走错了？我在二号。
3.en: Your cousin is waiting at Exit 3. The sign above you says Exit 2. Tell him, and ask, gently, if he's at the wrong one.
3.gloss: I'm at 2. Are you at the wrong one?
3.tip: 你是不是走错了？ = have you gone to the wrong one? Asking is gentler than 你走错了 (you're wrong).

steps.en: Don't move, I'm coming in to get you!

steps.zh: 行李多不多？我帮你拿，我帮你拿！
steps.en: Lots of bags? I'll carry them, I'll carry them!

say.en: He wants to come in and carry your bags. No need: you can manage.
answers: 不用不用，我一个人拿得动！
say.gloss: No, no, I can manage it.
say.tip: 不用不用 = no need, no need: twice makes it a warm no. 拿得动 = can carry it (拿不动 = can't).

ok.zh: 行行行，那我把车开到二号口！
ok.en: Fine, fine, I'll bring the van round to Exit 2, then!

fail.en: What? You want me to come in? On my way!

1.en: He wants to come in and carry your bags. No need.
1.tip: 不用不用 = no need: said twice, it's friendly, not cold.

answers: 不用麻烦了，我自己来就行。
不用麻烦你了，我拿得动。
真不用麻烦，我自己来就行。
3.en: He wants to come in and carry your bags. Turn him down politely: no need to go to any trouble.
3.gloss: Don't go to any trouble, I can manage.
3.tip: 不用麻烦了 = don't go to any trouble: the polite no to help. 我自己来就行 = I'll manage myself.

steps.zh: 哎，饿不饿？礼物带了没？奶奶六点就开始等了！
steps.en: Hey, are you hungry? Did you bring the presents? Grandma's been waiting since six!

steps.zh: 对了对了，有对象了没有？
steps.en: Oh, and, and: got a partner yet?

say.en: He's asking if you're seeing anyone. You're not: say so, and tell him to stop asking.

not.note: That says you DO have someone, and the whole family will know by midnight. Dodge it: 还没有！

say.tip: 还没有 = not yet. 别问了 = stop asking: said with a laugh to family, it's playful, not rude.

silence.en: Not a peep? So that's a yes!

silence.zh: 快说快说，好不好看？哪儿的人？
silence.en: Come on, come on: good-looking? Where are they from?

hangup.en: Right, I'm telling 二姨 this minute!
He hung up to tell 二姨. By the time you reach the van, the family group chat is congratulating you on a partner you don't have.

ok.zh: 好好好，不问了！反正明天二姨会问的。
ok.en: OK, OK, I'll drop it! 二姨 will ask you tomorrow anyway.

1.en: He's asking if you're seeing anyone. You're not.
1.tip: 没有没有 = no, no: said twice, it's a laughing brush-off.

3.en: He's asking if you're seeing anyone. You're not: dodge it, there's no rush.
3.gloss: Not yet. We'll see when the time comes.
3.tip: 到时候再说吧 = we'll see when the time comes: the classic dodge for any family question.

steps.zh: 那咱们先回家，还是先去吃夜宵？
steps.en: So: home first, or a late-night snack first?

say.en: 奶奶 has been waiting since six. Tell him: home first, Grandma's waiting.
answers: 还是先回家吧，奶奶在等。
say.tip: 先……吧 = let's … first. 奶奶等着呢 = Grandma's waiting: 着呢 says it's going on right now.

silence.zh: 喂？回家还是吃夜宵？说句话呀！
silence.en: Hello? Home or food? Say something!

silence.zh: 不说话我就替你定了啊！
silence.en: Say nothing and I'll decide for you!

hangup.en: Right, my call: food it is!
He decided for you: crayfish first, then 奶奶's soup at home. You're in bed by three, extremely full.

answers: 先吃夜宵，再回家看奶奶！

then.zh: 好嘞！我知道一家小龙虾，绝了！
then.en: You got it! I know a crayfish place. Unbeatable!

then.zh: 我妈他们都在那儿……啊不是，就咱俩！
then.en: My mum and everyone are already th... I mean, no! Just the two of us!
The crayfish stall, twenty minutes later: the whole family already at the table, gloves on, chopsticks up. An ambush. 奶奶 has brought her soup in a flask.
then.zh: 小龙虾摊上，全家人早就坐好了。

ok.zh: 好嘞！奶奶炖了一锅鸡汤，从八点热到现在！
ok.en: You got it! Grandma's made a whole pot of chicken soup. She's kept it hot since eight!

fail.zh: 啊？回家还是吃夜宵？你说清楚！
fail.en: What? Home or food? Make up your mind!

1.en: 奶奶 has been waiting since six. Tell him: home first.
1.tip: 先回家吧 = let's go home first (先 = first).

answers: 改天吧，今天先回家看奶奶。
改天再吃，先回家陪奶奶。
下次吧，奶奶还等着呢，先回家。
3.en: 奶奶 has been waiting since six. Turn down the snack for another night: home to Grandma first.
3.gloss: Another night. Tonight, home to Grandma.
3.tip: 改天吧 = another day: the soft way to turn down an invitation. 看奶奶 = go and see Grandma.

steps.en: Twenty minutes later: 奶奶 at the gate in her winter coat, waiting since six, with a pot of chicken soup kept hot since eight.
steps.zh: 奶奶穿着大衣，在门口等你。
